records.pathology_zh: 牙齒：齲齒、下顎齒槽皆已癒合、無牙導致骨吸收。脊椎：腰椎L5與髂骨擠壓產生病變與變形。肢骨：左橈骨近端關節炎（橈骨粗隆邊緣骨贅與凹陷）。腳骨：左腳跟骨骨刺（後方與下方）、右腳跟骨骨刺
records.pathology_en: Dental caries; healed mandibular alveoli and bone resorption associated with antemortem tooth loss. Compression-related pathology and deformation between L5 and the ilium. Arthritis of the left proximal radius with osteophytes and depression near the radial tuberosity. Calcaneal spurs on both feet.

records.pathology_zh: 頸椎椎體有骨質增生；腰椎第五節、指關節面有結節；牙齒多附著牙結石，且有齒槽膿瘍與部分齲齒的狀況；髕骨輕微骨刺
records.pathology_en: Cervical vertebral osteophytes; nodules on L5 and finger joint surfaces; heavy dental calculus, alveolar abscesses, and some caries; slight patellar osteophytes.

records.pathology_zh: 門齒皆有線狀磨耗痕跡；齒槽膿瘍、牙結石發生頻率高；股骨頭中心凹（fovea capitis）邊緣略凸出且鋒利，然嚴重程度尚未達到關節炎。右肱骨遠端滑車面、左尺骨近端關節面有骨質增生。頸椎椎體有結節，邊緣骨質增生
records.pathology_en: Linear wear marks on the incisors; frequent alveolar abscesses and calculus. The rim of the fovea capitis is slightly raised and sharp but does not reach the reported threshold for arthritis. Bone proliferation occurs on the distal right humeral trochlea and proximal left ulnar articular surface. Cervical vertebral bodies show nodules and marginal bone proliferation.
